_doc: Combos learned in the dojo. Each step is one input: L light, H heavy, J jump, D dash; a prefix F/B/U/Dn is the stick (forward = toward the way you face). Steps before the last play the normal move for that button; the last step is the finisher clip. Timing: after each strike connects (or a jump/dash starts) a ring closes on the fighter; pressing the next input as it closes is PERFECT (x1.5 damage, slow-mo), anywhere else in the window is GOOD, too late and the chain drops. fx: launch (pops them up and back), fling (sends them flying), knockdown (on the floor), stun (doubled over, can't swing), crush (smashed down).

son.name: FREERUN
son.blurb: Parkour on people. Momentum, flips, feet first. Light hits open, the street finishes.

father.name: DOCKYARD
father.blurb: Boxing with a dock worker's manners. Short, heavy, dirty: elbows, head, knees, shoulder.

combos.title: TIC-TAC TORNADO
combos.blurb: Jab, cross, then up + heavy: he jumps, turns a full circle and the heel comes round at head height.

combos.title: FLASH BACK
combos.blurb: Jab, then back + heavy: a backflip with the foot coming straight up through the chin. Gets you out, too.

combos.title: FREIGHT TRAIN
combos.blurb: Dash, jump, heavy: run, take off and put both feet in his chest. You land on your back and kip up - worth it.

combos.title: KNEE EXPRESS
combos.blurb: Jab, cross, forward + light: two running steps and a flying knee to the ribs. Doubles them over.

combos.title: FLOOR SWEEP
combos.blurb: Down + light, down + light, heavy: drop, spin on a hand, take both legs. They go down; you spring back up.

combos.title: CARTWHEEL CHOP
combos.blurb: Heavy, then forward + heavy: a cartwheel whose top leg comes down like an axe.

combos.title: SUPERMAN
combos.blurb: Dash, light, light: skip in, kick the back leg out and fly fist-first.

combos.title: SHIFT WHISTLE
combos.blurb: Jab, cross, forward + heavy: step in and turn the hips through a horizontal elbow.

combos.title: UNION BREAK
combos.blurb: Jab, heavy, up + heavy: both fists locked together over the head and down like a sledge. Puts them in the asphalt.

combos.title: DOCK BOOT
combos.blurb: Down + light twice, then forward + heavy: knee up high and the sole of the work boot goes through his chest. Sends him down the street.

combos.title: FREIGHT SHOULDER
combos.blurb: Jab, dash, heavy: head down, shoulder first, three steps of dock worker.

combos.title: NIGHT SHIFT
combos.blurb: Down + light, heavy: dip, liver hook, then the overhand right over the top.

combos.title: CLOCK OUT
combos.blurb: Heavy, then back + heavy: turn your back, spin, and the back of the fist ends the shift.

combos.title: COLLAR & CROWN
combos.blurb: Jab, cross, up + light: grab the collar, pull him in, forehead.

combos.title: LAST ORDERS
combos.blurb: Jab, heavy, forward + light: take the head in a clinch and drive the knee up. Twice.
